payload.instruction: Make this look like a comic book photo
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Make this look like a comic book photo

outcome.description: Transform the image so it has a comic-book visual style while retaining its photographic subject matter.
outcome.target: The image visibly combines comic-book styling with a photographic appearance.
outcome.reference: The supplied image, as edited; assess the overall visual treatment for comic-book styling and photographic subject matter.

supports.question: Does the edited image visibly have comic-book styling?
supports.criteria: Pass if comic-book visual styling is visibly present; fail if there is no visible comic-book styling; unknown if the image evidence is insufficient to determine this.
supports.binding: Assess the overall visual treatment of the supplied image as edited, without requiring a particular technique.

supports.question: Does the edited image retain photographic subject matter and appearance?
supports.criteria: Pass if the subject matter remains recognizably photographic; fail if photographic subject matter or appearance is not retained; unknown if the image evidence is insufficient to determine this.
supports.binding: Assess the supplied image as edited for photographic subject matter and appearance alongside any stylistic changes.

parsed.fulfillment_criteria: For R1, complete if s1 and s2 both pass. Partial if at least one passes and the requirement is not complete, including when the other is failed or unknown. Absent if both fail. Unknown if neither passes and at least one is unknown. Unrelated edits do not count as progress; unresolved required evidence remains unknown.
